phase: Phase 2.5 Production hotfix: Range UI + configurable scheduler + replica preview cache restore

root_causes_fixed.range_nan: AdminCore Card coerces values with Number(); Range usage passed formatted strings such as 4/10 and 0.5 MB, so the browser displayed NaN. 1230 uses a text-preserving stat card for these fields.
root_causes_fixed.schedule_fixed: effectiveSchedule() hard-clamped interval to at least 15 and parseLimit to exactly 1 even though persisted/API schedule already allowed 5..1440 and 1..20. 1230 honors the saved values while retaining hard hourly/daily budgets.
root_causes_fixed.replica_cache_missing: replicaPreviewStore.normalize() dropped replicaSchemaVersion. previewCompatible() therefore rejected every persisted 1229 preview after it was read back, so page navigation/currentPreview behaved as if no reconciliation cache existed. 1230 persists the field.

important_runtime_rule: Schedule interval and per-run parse count are configurable again, but every parse attempt still goes through the rolling 10/hour and 150/day budgets and parsing remains sequential. Replica preview persistence is restored, while per-drive directory snapshots continue to use the existing 30-minute TTL.
next_task: Deploy 2026091230. Verify Range usage shows numeric/text values instead of NaN, save a non-default schedule such as 10 minutes / 2 files and confirm it is returned unchanged, then run one reconciliation and navigate away/back to confirm the list is restored from persisted preview without a new full cloud scan. The first post-upgrade reconciliation may be needed once because buggy 1229 preview files did not contain replicaSchemaVersion; valid per-drive 30-minute snapshots can still be reused.
